parameters.content:
## ENV VARS requeridas en el contenedor n8n (EasyPanel)

`N8N_WEBHOOK_DEALER_SIGNUP_SECRET` - secreto HMAC (mismo que en Vercel)
`RESEND_API_KEY` - clave API de Resend
`MAIL_FROM` - ej: Black Label Market <no-reply@blacklabelmarket.es>
`ADMIN_EMAIL` - ej: aldeiaceo@gmail.com
`SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL` - incoming webhook de Slack
`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` - clave API de Anthropic
`FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` - clave API de Firecrawl
`SUPABASE_URL` - ej: https://xxx.supabase.co
`SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY` - service_role key de Supabase
`MARKET_URL` - ej: https://blacklabelmarket.es

Vercel debe tener:
`N8N_WEBHOOK_DEALER_SIGNUP=https://aldeia-n8n.giuxk6.easypanel.host/webhook/blm/dealer-signup`
`N8N_WEBHOOK_DEALER_SIGNUP_SECRET=<mismo valor>`
